title: The 10 Best Benchtop Jointers
subtitle: Benchtop and compact jointers for flattening and squaring boards, ranked from live Amazon data.
intro: A jointer flattens a board's face and squares its edge so it can be planed and glued up straight. We ranked 10 best-sellers from WEN, Cutech, Wahuda, CRAFTSMAN and JET on rating, review volume and features (a spiral cutterhead, cast iron tables, 8-inch or wider capacity and carbide inserts).

changelog.note: Page published with 10 ranked picks and 1 tool to avoid.

products.name: WEN JT630H 10-Amp 6-Inch Spiral Benchtop Jointer
products.verdict: The best-selling and most-reviewed jointer here: a 6-inch benchtop with a spiral head for a fine finish, for under $300.
products.best_for: Hobby shops flattening and edging boards on a budget.
products.skip_if: You joint long boards; a 30-inch table is short.

products.name: Cutech 40180HI 8-Inch Spiral Benchtop Jointer with Cast Iron Tables and Carbide Inserts
products.verdict: An 8-inch benchtop jointer with carbide inserts and cast iron tables, the kind of features usually found on floor-standing machines.
products.best_for: Serious hobbyists who want 8-inch capacity in a benchtop.

products.name: Cutech 401120HI-IF 12-Inch Spiral Benchtop Jointer with Cast Iron Tables and Fence
products.verdict: A 12-inch benchtop jointer with carbide inserts, cast iron tables and a cast iron fence, wide enough to flatten most furniture boards in one pass.
products.best_for: Woodworkers who mill wide boards in a small shop.
products.skip_if: You're on a budget; it's one of the priciest here.

products.name: Cutech 40160HB 6-Inch Spiral Benchtop Jointer with Carbide Inserts (401HCB)
products.verdict: Cutech's 6-inch jointer with carbide inserts, tied for the best rating here at 4.8 stars.
products.best_for: Small shops that want carbide on a budget.

products.name: CRAFTSMAN 10 Amp Benchtop Jointer, Variable Speed (CMEW020)
products.verdict: A brand-name benchtop jointer with variable speed and a center-mounted fence, using straight knives.
products.best_for: Occasional jointing with a brand you can find parts for.
products.skip_if: You want a smoother spiral finish.

products.name: Cutech 401100HI 10-Inch Spiral Benchtop Jointer with Cast Iron Tables
products.verdict: A 10-inch Cutech with carbide inserts and cast iron tables, rated 4.8 stars.
products.best_for: Woodworkers who want wider than 8 inches without a floor machine.

products.name: WEN JT833H 10-Amp 8-Inch Spiral Benchtop Jointer with Extendable Table
products.verdict: WEN's 8-inch spiral jointer with support arms that extend the table to 51 inches for longer boards.

products.name: Wahuda Tools 10-inch Spiral Benchtop Jointer, Cast Iron Tables, 4-Sided Carbide
products.verdict: A 10-inch jointer with four-sided carbide inserts (four fresh edges per insert) and cast iron tables with pull-out extensions.
products.best_for: Woodworkers who want long insert life.
cons: Reviews shared with the 8 in model

products.name: WEN JT3062 10-Amp 6-Inch 2-Blade Benchtop Jointer

specs.extras: Up to 22,000 cuts per minute, depth scale

products.verdict: A basic two-knife WEN jointer rated 4.7 stars.

products.name: JET 6-Inch Long Bed Jointer, 1 HP (JJ-6CSDX)
products.verdict: A floor-standing long-bed jointer for straightening long boards, with a 1 HP motor and a rabbeting ledge.
products.best_for: Shops that joint long boards and want a full-size machine.

avoid.name: 6-Inch Benchtop Jointer, 15-Amp 13000 RPM Pure Copper Motor
avoid.verdict: A 6-inch benchtop jointer claiming a 15-amp motor, more than any benchtop here, with a short aluminum table and a 2.4-star rating.
reasons: It claims a '15A' motor, while Cutech calls its 12-amp benchtop motors the most powerful available and the WEN jointers run 10 amps.
Its 22.8-inch table is shorter than the 30-inch tables on WEN's 6-inch jointers, and shorter tables make straightening boards harder.
It's rated 2.4 stars. The WEN JT630H costs more but has a spiral head and 1,073 reviews.

buyers_guide.a: A jointer flattens one face and squares one edge. A planer then makes the opposite face parallel at a set thickness. For rough lumber you need both, or a planer sled.
6 inches handles edges and narrow boards. 8 to 12 inches lets you flatten wider boards for tabletops without ripping them first.
Spiral (helical) heads cut with a shearing action, so they're quieter and tear out less on figured wood. Carbide inserts last much longer than HSS.
Longer tables straighten longer boards. Benchtop jointers work best on boards up to about twice the table length.
Always use push blocks, never joint pieces shorter than about 12 inches, and keep the guard in place.
